title: Aussie Vego Burgers
subtitle: with Roasted Beets and Mixed Salad
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Peel the beetroot, halve and thinly slice. Thinly slice the onion into rings. Cut the rolls in half. Brush the plant-based patties with 2 tsp olive oil, then scatter over half the Aussie barbecue seasoning, pressing to coat.

Roast veggies: Put the beetroot and onion on the lined tray (see Make it yours). Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, scatter over the remaining Aussie barbecue seasoning, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast the veggies on the upper oven shelf, turning halfway, for 20 mins or until tender.

Pan-fry patties: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for 4-5 mins each side until browned. Remove from the pan and cover to keep warm. Put the rolls on an oven tray, cut-side up, and bake on the lower shelf for 5-6 mins until lightly toasted.

Fry eggs and toss salad: While the rolls are in the oven, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Crack 2 eggs into the pan and cook for 3-4 mins until just set or cooked to your liking. Remove the pan from the heat. Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the salad leaves and toss to coat.

Serve up: Spread the roll bases with the mayonnaise. Layer with half the salad leaves, the patties, eggs, beetroot and onion. Drizzle with the barbecue sauce, if using, then sandwich with the roll tops. Serve with the remaining salad leaves and enjoy!
Make it yours: An Aussie burger goes well with a side of fries. If you have any potatoes on hand, cut them into chips and roast them at the same time as the other veggies.
